title: Revolutionizing Smallholder Farming through Integrated Supply Chains
subtitle: What the Sahyadri Farms (FPC) model means for our Mandals & Districts
audience: Officer Training Session | Government of Andhra Pradesh
source_note: Source: Sancheti et al., Journal of Postharvest Technology, 2024.

sections.title: The Problem We Are Trying to Solve

items.title: Climate stress
items.body: Erratic weather, unpredictable water, and pests put fragile smallholder incomes at constant risk.

items.title: Fragmented supply chains
items.body: Poor coordination among players raises cost and blocks access to markets, quality inputs and timely information.

items.title: Post-harvest losses
items.body: Around 40% of produce never reaches the market due to weak storage, processing and logistics.

items.title: Tiny, scattered holdings
items.body: Small & marginal farmers cannot reach economies of scale alone; past co-operatives largely under-delivered.

sections.title: The Answer: Aggregate Farmers into an FPC

blocks.text: A Farmer Producer Company (FPC) is registered under the Companies Act, owned and democratically run by farmer-members, with professional managers handling day-to-day operations.
It lets small farmers act at scale — managing the whole chain from input to market.

sections.title: Sahyadri Farms at a Glance
sections.lead: Nashik, Maharashtra • Founded 27 Dec 2010 by farmer Vilas Shinde • India's largest grape producer

blocks.text: Started as just 4 smallholder farmers with a shared vision.

sections.title: How the Model Works: One Integrated Chain

blocks.closing: The FPC owns every link — so margins that once leaked to middlemen stay with farmers, and quality is controlled end-to-end.

items.title: Agro-advisory teams
items.body: Experts guide crop choice, cultivation, pest & soil management — building farmer skills.

items.title: Pack-house & processing
items.body: Sorting, grading, packaging plus dehydration/pulping/canning add value & consistency.

items.title: Cold storage & logistics
items.body: Optimal temperature/humidity extends shelf life and slashes post-harvest loss.

items.title: Modern tech
items.body: Precision agriculture, GPS, drones and drip irrigation cut input waste, raise yields.

items.title: Blockchain & ERP
items.body: Full traceability and transparent, fair-trade pricing — a first among Indian FPCs.

cols.title: For Farmers
items: Direct access to domestic & export markets

cols.title: For Consumers
items: Strict quality assurance to global standards

items.title: Identify & mobilise
items.body: Map crops with surplus/loss; convene smallholders around one or two high-value crops. Start small — Sahyadri began with 4 farmers.

items.title: Form / revive the FPC
items.body: Register or re-activate an FPC. Lock in farmer ownership + professional management from day one.

items.title: Build shared infrastructure
items.body: Phase pack-house, grading and cold storage as volumes grow. Pool member capital + leverage govt & FI partnerships.

items.title: Adopt technology & traceability
items.body: Introduce agro-advisory, precision inputs, drip irrigation, and ERP/traceability for transparent pricing.

items.title: Link to markets & scale
items.body: Secure direct buyers, retail, e-commerce and exports. Reinvest surplus; expand crops and villages.

items.title: Climate & water risk
items.body: Drought-resistant varieties, precision/drip irrigation, climate-smart practices.

items.title: Soil & resource overuse
items.body: Organic fertilisers, crop rotation, integrated pest management to protect long-term fertility.

items.title: Heavy capital needs
items.body: Phase infrastructure investment; blend member capital with FI and government partnerships.

items.title: Coordination across stakeholders
items.body: Engage farmers, govt, research bodies & private partners; share knowledge and risk.

items.title: Staying competitive
items.body: Embed continuous improvement — feedback, evaluation and innovation at every level.

items.title: Aggregation is the unlock
items.body: An FPC turns scattered small farmers into a market force. Without scale, none of the rest works.

items.title: Own the chain, not just the farm
items.body: Value leaks at every handoff. Capturing processing, storage and sales keeps margins with farmers.

items.title: Sequence the investment
items.body: Start with people & advisory; build pack-house, cold chain and tech as revenue grows.

items.title: Technology builds trust
items.body: ERP, blockchain and traceability convert quality into premium prices and loyal buyers.

items.title: Start small, think long
items.body: From 4 farmers to ₹1,000 Cr — patient, compounding growth, not a one-off scheme.

sections.title: From Case Study to Action
sections.source: Source: Sancheti, Sanghavi, Sanghavi & Sancheti (2024), Journal of Postharvest Technology, 12(3): 37-49.

blocks.title: Your task before you leave today:
items: Name 1 high-value crop in your mandal suited to an FPC pilot.
Identify an existing FPO/FPC to revive — or farmers to mobilise.
List the partners (banks, govt schemes) you can bring to the table.

blocks.text: A model of best practice — inspiring others to emulate its success.
